name: How quickly do I need to address storm flood damage to prevent mold?

mainEntity.name: How quickly do I need to address storm flood damage to prevent mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: To effectively prevent mold growth, it is critical to begin water extraction and drying within 24-48 hours of the flood event. Mold can start to develop on damp surfaces within this timeframe. The longer moisture remains, the higher the risk of extensive mold contamination, which can lead to more complex and costly remediation. Prompt professional intervention ensures thorough drying and mitigation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin water extraction and drying within 24-48 hours of a flood to prevent mold growth, which can start quickly in damp conditions.
